CookiesPreferences.header: We use cookies to enhance your experience on our website.
CookiesPreferences.technicalCookies: Technical Cookies: are nesessary cookies for the website to function correctly and cannot be switched off. Examples are user language preference and cookie concent choice. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
CookiesPreferences.functionalCookies: Functional Cookies: are needed to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation specifically via AI Agent powered Chatbot. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
